extension.summary: tofa media server: user interface, plus a browsable video source
extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - When a title will not load because your server is busy rather than unreachable, tofa now says so. It used to tell you to check your connection even when the connection was fine and the server was simply taking too long to answer, which sent you looking at the one part that was working. - Cast & Crew fills in one go. The photographs used to arrive a few at a time, leaving half the panel empty for several seconds on a 4K box; tofa now collects them while you are still on the title's main page. The People results in Search are quicker for the same reason. - Discover and Collections fill the same way. Their artwork comes from tofa's cloud rather than from your own server, and Kodi was filing every picture away itself before it drew it -- on a cold Discover tab that took twenty seconds. tofa now fetches what is on screen up front and the rest quietly behind it. - tofa no longer leaves background work and open connections behind when it has finished with a screen. On a box left running all day this showed up as memory creeping upwards.
